title: Fix 'Invalid argument' error in SANE
summary: Resolve the 'sane_start: Invalid argument' error which often occurs when the device is not specified or firmware is missing. Specifying the device explicitly usually fixes it.

steps.explain: List available devices to find the correct device name.
Run the scan command again, explicitly specifying the device name found in the previous step. Replace <DEVICE_NAME> with the actual string.

placeholders.name: DEVICE_NAME
placeholders.description: The device identifier string from scanimage -L output
